newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ C 134 of April 29, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ C 134 of April 29, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

Joint call for proposals for RTD activities on transmissible spongiform encephalopathies under the specific programmes of research and technological development, including demonstration, in the fields of agriculture and fisheries (including agro-industry, food technologies, forestry, aquaculture and rural development), of biotechnology, of biomedicine and health (1994 to 1998) (97/C 134/07)
Outcome of the invitation to tender (Community food aid) (97/C 134/05)

Proposal for a Council Decision concluding the Agreement for scientific and technological cooperation between the European Community and the Republic of South Africa (97/C 134/04) COM(97) 119 final - 97/0112(CNS)
Authorization for State aid pursuant to Articles 92 and 93 of the EC Treaty Cases where the Commission raises no objections (97/C 134/03)
LIST OF DOCUMENTS FORWARDED BY THE COMMISSION TO THE COUNCIL DURING THE PERIOD 14 TO 18. 4. 1997 (97/C 134/02)
